result.title: Ideas On The Move: Siviwe Gwarube
result.description:
'What really drives me is a deep sense of injustice.'

South Africa’s youngest cabinet minister Siviwe Gwarube explains her transformative plan to raise investment in new schools and early learning.

Her ultimate goal? To bring 4 million children into South Africa’s early childhood centres.

result.description:

Her method? Explaining an idea so it's clear to both five-year-olds and 40-year-olds.

result.title: Ideas On The Move: Anurag Maloo
result.description:
‘We are responsible for natural disasters and we need to take action.’

Only a few years ago, Anurag Maloo faced death on one of the world’s most dangerous mountains. 

In 2023, he was abseiling down #Annapurna when he slipped due to a rope failure and fell into a crevasse. Maloo was trapped for three days before a rescue team found him unconscious. After doctors performed CPR for four hours, the mountaineer faced a long period of rehab in which he lost the fingers on his right hand and had to relearn how to stand and walk.

Despite his near-death experience, Maloo, founder of The Voice Of Glaciers, has dedicated his life to educating the world about how we all depend on mountains and nature.

result.title: Cybersecurity needs a new playbook for AI
result.description:
‘We're talking about new speed, we're talking about new scale, we are not necessarily talking about new problems.’

As #AI increases in power and scale, so do the opportunities for those who would use it as a weapon or tool for criminality. 

The global response to these threats is not yet up to speed, argues Kat Duffy, Senior Fellow for Digital and Cyberspace Policy at the Council on Foreign Relations. What’s needed is a new partnership between governments and the private sector - an international framework for cooperation, knowledge-sharing and enforcement. And as she explains here, the world already knows how to build it. 

The World Economic Forum’s Global Future Council for Cybersecurity convenes experts to improve cyber resilience practices across organizations and establish robust governance to safeguard our digital societies and economy.

result.title: Ideas On The Move: Ahmad Joudeh
result.description:
“I used dance as a voice for my people.”

For ballet dancer and choreographer @ahmadjoudehofficial, #dance has always been about more than performance. Growing up as a stateless refugee in Syria, the self-taught dancer has used it to stay alive. 

Despite war, displacement and prejudice, Ahmad never gave up on his craft. Dance or Die, a 2018 documentary, shed light on his determination to pursue his art.

Joining us in Dubai, UAE for #AMGFL26, he shared his mission to inspire all artists to believe in themselves in times of adversity.
